children: Canada’s new housing prices fell 0.1% month over month in August 2026, matching the decline recorded in July.
The drop was also the same as in the previous two months and remained the smallest since prices last increased in February.
House-only prices decreased 0.1%, following a 0.2% decline in July, while land prices were unchanged after falling 0.1% in the previous month.

title: Canada New Housing Prices Extend Monthly Decline
